title: Shared contract definitions
description: Shared scalar constraints referenced by Vis payload schemas.

x-vis-error-messages.description: The one message table of schema and live view faults. The engine and every SDK render each fault line from it. A line holds only names and limits of the schema, never a value that a person wrote.

keywords.enum: the value is not one of {allowed}
keywords.minimum: the number is less than the minimum {limit}
keywords.maximum: the number is greater than the maximum {limit}
keywords.exclusiveMinimum: the number must be greater than {limit}
keywords.exclusiveMaximum: the number must be less than {limit}
keywords.minItems: the array has {count} items, the minimum is {limit}
keywords.maxItems: the array has {count} items, the maximum is {limit}
keywords.minLength: the string has {count} characters, the minimum is {limit}
keywords.maxLength: the string has {count} characters, the maximum is {limit}
keywords.pattern: the string does not match the pattern of the schema
keywords.oneOf: the value matches none of the allowed forms
keywords.uniqueItems: the array holds an item two times
keywords.format: the string is not a valid {limit}

view_not_map: a live view is a map of title and nodes
view_not_json: a live view holds only JSON data
node_not_map: the node is not a map
child_not_map: the child is not a map
group_needs_id: a group needs an id, because a patch names a group by its id. Write vis.ui.group("actions", ...)
too_many_nodes: the view has {count} nodes, the maximum is {limit}. Put a collection in a table, because rows do not count as nodes
picture_budget: the pictures hold {count} bytes, the maximum is {limit}
read_only: only the host writes this property
secret_value: only the host holds the value of a secret input
secret_default: a secret input takes no default
live_validate: a live input takes no validate list. Give validate= to the input of the SDK; the extension runs it
repeated_option: two options have the same value
line_tones: give one tone or null for each line
grid_columns: only a grid group takes max_columns
toolbar_menu: a toolbar menu holds only buttons and groups of buttons
thread_anchor: a diff thread needs an anchor
lane_order: the lane ends before it starts
table_order: the order names no column of the table
table_selection: a selected id names no row of the table
not_selectable: only a selectable table or card takes this property
mesh_shadow: the mesh has the name of a built-in mesh
face_vertex: a face names a missing vertex
unknown_mesh: the object names an unknown mesh
id_name: the id and the name of an input differ
range_order: min is not less than max
range_step: the step is not positive or does not fit between min and max
default_domain: the default is outside the domain of the input
value_domain: the value is outside the domain of the input
shortcut_dropped: the shortcut is dropped, because node {id} has a fault
shortcut_needs_app: only an app (placement attachment) takes shortcuts
repeated_shortcut_key: an earlier shortcut has the same key
shortcut_target: the node that node_id names is not in the view
shortcut_not_pressable: the node that node_id names is not a button or a selectable card
table_rows: the table has {count} rows, its max_rows is {limit}
op_target: the {op} op does not apply to a node of type {type}
op_key: the {op} op on a node of type {type} does not take this property
missing_node: the view has no such node; it has {ids}
missing_after: the view has no node {after} to put this node after
own_thread: a thread node takes only the thread that has its own id
patch_seq: the patch has seq {seq}, but it must be greater than the view seq {view_seq}
